Sardakk N'orr.text: During the "Commit Ground Forces" step: You can commit (move) up to 1 ground force from each planet in the active system and each planet in adjacent systems that do not contain 1 of your command tokens.

The Arborec.text: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your units that have Production: You may produce 1 unit in that system.

The Barony of Letnev.text: After 1 of your units uses Sustain Damage: You may gain 1 trade good.

The Clan of Saar.text: When you produce fighters or infantry: You may place each of those units at any of your space docks that are not blockaded.

The Embers of Muaat.text: After you spend a token from your strategy pool: You may gain 1 trade good.

The Emirates of Hacan.text: When you cast votes: You may spend any number of trade goods: cast 2 additional votes for each trade good spent.

The Federation of Sol.text: At the start of a ground combat on a planet you control: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.

The Ghosts of Creuss.text: After your ships move: For each ship that has a capacity value and moved through 1 or more wormholes, you may place 1 fighter from your reinforcements with that ship if you have unused capacity in the active system.

The L1z1x Mindnet.text: At any time: Units that have Planetary Shield do not prevent you from using Bombardment.

The Mentak Coalition.text: After you win a space combat: You may force your opponent to give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

The Naalu Collective.text: At any time: You may look at your neighbors' hands of promissory notes and the top and bottom card of the agenda deck.

The Nekro Virus.text: After you gain a technology: You may draw 1 action card.

The Universities of Jol-Nar.text: After you roll dice for a unit ability: You may reroll any of those dice.

The Winnu.text: During combat: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls in the Mecatol Rex system, your home system, and each system that contains a legendary planet.

The Xxcha Kingdom.text: When you vote: Each planet you exhaust to cast votes provides 1 additional vote. Game effects cannot prevent you from voting on an agenda.

The Yin Brotherhood.text: At any time: This card satisfies a green technology prerequisite. When you research a tech owned by another player, you may return 1 of your infantry to reinforcements to ignore its prerequisites.

The Yssaril Tribes.text: After another player activates a system that contains your units: You may look at that player's action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

The Argent Flight.text: When 1 or more of your units make a roll for a unit ability: You may choose 1 of those units to roll 1 additional die.

The Empyrean.text: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 of your command tokens: You may return that token to your reinforcements.

The Mahact Gene-sorcerers.text: During setup, you must place one of your command tokens in the Mahact player's fleet pool; this token cannot be discarded or spent.

The Naaz-Rokha Alliance.text: After you gain control of a planet that was controlled by another player: You may explore that planet.

The Nomad.text: When you produce: You can produce your flagship without spending resources.

The Titans of Ul.text: When 1 or more of your units use Production: You may gain 1 trade good.

The Vuil'raith Cabal.text: When you produce fighter or infantry units: Up to 2 of those units do not count against your Production limit.

The Council Keleres.text: After you perform a component action: You may perform an additional action.

Last Bastion.text: Your action cards cannot be canceled by "Sabotage" action cards. The Nekro Virus cannot place assimilator tokens on your components.

The Ral Nel Consortium.text: When you delcare a retreat: Immediately retreat up to 2 of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. Place a command token from your reinforcements into that system.

The Deepwrought Scholarate.text: When another player spends resources to research a technology: That player may reduce the cost by 1; if they do, gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

The Crimson Rebellion.text: At the end of a combat between any players: Gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

The Firmament / The Obsidian.text: You may treat planets in systems that contain your ships as if you controlled them for the purpose of scoring secret objectives.

Augurs of Ilyxum.text: Ongoing This card satisfies a yellow technology prerequisite. When you cast at least 1 vote, cast 1 additional vote for every 2 technologies you own.

Celdauri Trade Confederation.text: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your space docks, gain 1 commodity. Your ships may treat systems that contain 1 or more of your space docks as adjacent to each other.

Dih-Mohn Flotilla.text: Ongoing This card satisfies a red technology prerequisite. At the start of a space combat in a system that contains 3 or more different types of your non-fighter ships, produce 1 hit against your opponent's ships.

Florzen Profiteers.text: After the second agenda is revealed during the agenda phase: You may ready 1 planet you control. Explore that planet, if able.

Free Systems Compact.text: After you gain control of a non-home planet during a tactical action: If you have 1 or more ships in the active system, you may produce 1 ship in that system.

Ghemina Raiders.text: After you win a space combat in a system that contains no planets or a planet with a structure You may gain 1 trade good.

Glimmer of Mortheus.text: At the start of a space combat while you are not the active player: Choose 1 of your non-fighter ships in the active system to gain Sustain Damage until the end of combat.

Kollecc Society.text: Ongoing This card satisfies a blue technology prerequisite. When you retreat, if the active system does not contain 1 of your command tokens, you do not place a command token in the system your ships retreated to.

Kortali Tribunal.text: During the first round of a combat: You may cancel 1 hit produced against your units.

Li-Zho Dynasty.text: During a round of combat in which no more than 1 of your non-fighter ships or 1 of your infantry is participating: You may choose 1 of your units in that combat, that unit rolls 1 additional combat die.

L'Tokk Khrask.text: At the start of invasion in a system that contains 1 or more planets: You may place 1 infantry unit from your reinforcements in the active system's space area if you have unused capacity in that system. Note: this occurs even if you control all planets in the system

Mirveda Protectorate.text: During Movement: For each infantry you transport, you may replace that unit with 1 fighter. You may use the Space Cannon of 1 of your units against ships that are adjacent to that unit's system.

Myko-Mentori.text: After another player produces 1 or more hits against your units during space combat: You may spend 1 commodity or 1 trade good to cancel 1 of those hits.

Nivyn Star Kings.text: Note: different means different types of anomaly, i.e. cannot be unlocked via 2 asteroid fields During combat: When 1 or more of your damaged units make a combat roll, up to 2 of those units may roll an additional combat die.

Olradin League.text: When you pass: You may exhaust 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex to gain a number of trade goods equal to that planet's resource or influence value.

Roh'Dhna Mechatronics.text: When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Construction" strategy card You may resolve the primary ability instead.

Savages of Cymiae.text: After you gain control of a planet during a tactical action: You may discard 1 action card to place or move 1 mech onto that planet.

Shipwrights of Axis.text: After a player resolves an Axis Order card: You may spend 6 resources to gain the corresponding unit's unit upgrade technology.

Tnelis Syndicate.text: After you activate a system: You may produce and assign 1 hit to a non-fighter ship you control in a system to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships in that system until the end of this tactical action.

Vaden Banking Clans.text: At the start of the status phase: Gain 1 trade good for each secret objective you have scored and 1 commodity for each public objective you have scored.

Vaylerian Scourge.text: After you activate a system: Choose 1 ship you control with a capacity value, apply +2 to that value during this tactical action.

Veldyr Sovereignty.text: When you research a technology that is owned by a player who controls a planet with a Branch Office attachment: You may ignore 1 prerequisite on that technology.

Zealots of Rhodun.text: When researching a technology: You may use the technology specialty of 1 planet you control to ignore any 1 prerequisite on the technology card you are researching.

Zelian Purifier.text: Ongoing Each of your Dreadnoughts and War Suns without Anti-Fighter Barrage gains Anti-Fighter Barrage 5.

Bentor Conglomerate.text: Ongoing Your commodity value is increased by 1.

Berserkers of Kjalengard.text: When researching a unit upgrade technology: Each of your unit upgrade technologies may satisfy 1 prerequisite it shares with the technology you are researching.

Cheiran Hordes.text: While you are the defender: After another player produces 1 or more hits against your units during ground combat, you may spend 1 commodity or 1 trade good to cancel 1 of those hits.

Edyn Mandate.text: When any game effect would allow you to score a public objective: You may instead draw 1 secret objective.

Ghoti Wayfarers.text: After you activate a system: You may treat systems that contain no planets as adjacent to each other during this tactical action.

Gledge Union.text: When you use the Production of 1 or more of your units You may increase the total Production value of those units by 1 for each space dock you control.

Kyro Sodality.text: When you cast votes: Remove any number of your infantry from the game board to cast 1 additional vote for each infantry removed.

Lanefir Remnants.text: After you explore a planet: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.

The Monks of Kolume.text: Ongoing: Apply +1 to each of your unit's ability rolls.

Nokar Sellships.text: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat: If you announced a retreat, cancel up to 2 hits. During combat, you may treat the active system as adjacent to each system adjacent to your home system.
